passage.text: How's Vietnam? I hope you aren't getting lost again!
passage.reading: ˈhaʊz ˌviːɛtˈnɑːm? aɪ ˈhoʊp juː ˈɑːrnt ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈlɔːst əˈɡɛn!

passage.text: We came home from Japan last night, and the journey was a nightmare.
passage.reading: wiː ˈkeɪm ˈhoʊm frəm dʒəˈpæn ˈlæst ˈnaɪt, ənd ðə ˈdʒɜːrni wʌz ə ˈnaɪtmɛr.

passage.text: First, our flight from Osaka was delayed for three hours.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrst, aʊr ˈflaɪt frəm oʊˈsɑːkə wʌz dɪˈleɪd fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: While we were waiting, they changed the gate, and we had to run!
passage.reading: waɪl wiː wɜːr ˈweɪtɪŋ, ðeɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒd ðə ˈɡeɪt, ənd wiː ˈhæd tə ˈrʌn!

passage.text: Then my bag didn't arrive in Bangkok, so I had to go to the baggage desk.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn maɪ ˈbæɡ ˈdɪdənt əˈraɪv ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, soʊ aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌdɛsk.

passage.text: Our car was in the parking lot, and we waited for the shuttle bus for forty minutes.
passage.reading: aʊr ˈkɑːr wʌz ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˌlɑːt, ənd wiː ˈweɪtɪd fər ðə ˈʃʌtəl ˌbʌs fər ˈfɔːrti ˈmɪnɪts.

passage.text: We got home at two in the morning, and I was exhausted.
passage.reading: wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈhoʊm ət ˈtuː ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ənd aɪ wʌz ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd.

passage.text: Dad says he has jet lag today, but Japan is only two hours ahead of Thailand!
passage.reading: ˈdæd ˈsɛz hiː ˈhæz ˈdʒɛt ˌlæɡ təˈdeɪ, bʌt dʒəˈpæn ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈtuː ˈaʊərz əˈhɛd əv ˈtaɪlænd!

passage.text: Luckily, the airline found my bag, and they're bringing it to my house today.
passage.reading: ˈlʌkəli, ði ˈɛrlaɪn ˈfaʊnd maɪ ˈbæɡ, ənd ðɛr ˈbrɪŋɪŋ ɪt tə maɪ ˈhaʊs təˈdeɪ.
